## Synopsis

An outing with the Explorer's Club of Pittsburgh. We hiked through the night to reach our rock climbing objective at Seneca Rocks, WV. We summitted and bivied atop the rocks.

Partners: Evren G., Dan M.

Route: Old Man's (5.3)
